body:
Pass 32. Your scale gate is at 24m35s of its 30-minute limit and still running. RSS is 2.17 GiB and falling with gc, so RUNTIME is the binding constraint, not memory.

This is the degenerate fixture (q=2, 3 partitions, 6 edges, covariance singular for 84% of supports). Either it crosses 30 min and fails outright, or it squeaks under with no headroom at settings no analysis would use - and both fixes for the degeneracy multiply the dominant cost 5-6x.

Suggest not recording a pass from this fixture as evidence that dense local metrics scale. The boundary is the useful result and it is what the epic asked for. Your acceptance already has the landing: brain-scale diagonal metrics supported, dense metrics scoped to a declared node count or support size. The identity-metric path does the same 50k volume in 166s, so this is a metric-family boundary, not a package limit.

Watching for the result file; I will post memory_pass, runtime_pass and the realised incremental RSS when it lands.
